note: Alberta Parks recreation area at the confluence of Watson Creek and the McLeod River, ~38 km SW of Robb on a gravel road. Well-treed drive-in sites for RVs and tents, plus six walk-in tent sites; free firewood; group firepit near sites 14-20. Operated by West Fraser Mills with the Fox Creek Development Association. The operator says snow can stay on the campground road into the first two weeks of May. Rainbow/bull trout and whitefish fishing. --Claude
